in_marathi.name: Shivkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Shiva, Lord of Destruction and Transformation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Shiva, the destroyer of evil and creator of the universe, and Kumar, meaning young or prince. This name carries the power and strength of Lord Shiva, making it an ideal choice for a child who is destined for greatness and transformation.
